bibl.title: Nochmals zum Ende von Soknopaiu Nesos.
bibl.seg: Andrea Jördens, Nochmals zum Ende von Soknopaiu Nesos.
Paola Davoli & Natascia Pellé (edd.), Πολυμάθεια. Studi Classici offerti a Mario Capasso (Lecce, 2018) pp. 253-264
bibl.note: In Roman times, Soknopaiou Nesos experienced its first and only period of continuous settlement. This was mainly due to the unique festival culture that attracted visitors from far and wide. Fifty years after the severe losses of the Antonine plague, the remaining inhabitants eventually realized that the former success could not be revitalized, and abandoned the place.
